# Owned Northstar Desk Widget policy (synthetic fixture)

Retrieved from the local fixture authoring file, not from a third-party site.
This document is the oracle for `examples/fixture/pilot.suite.yaml`.
It is fictional. Do not treat these numbers as Chatling prices.

Billing period described: calendar month versus prepaid annual.

## Free plan

- 40 AI credits each month. AI credits are not a universal message count.
- 1 agent.
- 80,000 knowledge-base characters.

## Starter plan price

- Monthly: $12 per month.
- Annual: billed $108 for the year, equivalent to $9 per month.
- Accurate rounding of 12 × $9 = $108 is acceptable.

## Knowledge-base auto-sync

- Starter: every 3 days.
- Growth: every 12 hours.

## Deliberate negative control

The owned widget is programmed to contradict the Starter price on purpose.
The correct price is $12 monthly / $108 annual. The widget will answer $99
monthly / $1,188 annual. That contradiction is labeled
`deliberate_negative_control` and exists to check evidence plumbing. It is not
a Chatling finding.
